command_new_session_detail: Start a clean conversation in this project.
command_search_detail: Find text in the current conversation.
command_terminal_detail: Open or close the project terminal.
command_files_detail: Browse files in the current workspace.
command_skills_detail: Browse the reusable instructions available to this project.
no_sessions_found: No matching sessions. Switch to Projects to open a workspace.
setup_detail: A private project folder is ready. Choose another folder only when you want to work in an existing repository.
setup_welcome_detail: Choose a project and Pi Agent will open an isolated assistant that can inspect files, make changes and run commands with your approval.
setup_step_workspace_detail: Pick the repository you want this agent to understand.
setup_step_runtime_detail: Wabou prepares the Pi runtime and keeps it isolated.
setup_step_prompt_detail: Ask a question first, or give the agent work to complete.
setup_safety: This folder will be created when the agent starts. You can browse to an existing repository instead.
proxy_scope: Used by Bun/npm package installation and every provider request.
agent_isolation: Each project owns an isolated Pi RPC process and sessions.
skills_intro: Reusable instructions available to {project}, from project and user directories.
no_skills: No skills are installed for this project yet.
select_skill: Select a skill to read its instructions.
settings_intro: Configure the current project, session behavior, and app-wide defaults.
current_agent_detail: Choose the workspace and optional provider/model overrides for this project.
session_behavior_detail: Control how Pi manages long contexts and queued instructions.
auto_compaction_detail: Summarize older context before the model's context window fills.
steering_queue_mode_detail: Choose whether Pi consumes one steering message per turn or all waiting messages together.
follow_up_queue_mode_detail: Choose whether Pi consumes one follow-up per completed task or the entire queue.
application_settings_detail: Defaults shared by every project on this device.
language_detail: Choose the interface language for this desktop client.
provider_detail: Projects use these values unless they define an override above.
proxy_detail: Wabou exports HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and ALL_PROXY before spawning Bun. This covers downloading the Pi npm package and subsequent provider traffic.
runtime_detail: Set WABOU_PI_BIN to bypass package resolution and use a managed Pi installation. A QuickJS-native executor remains a future option.
subagents_detail: Delegate bounded work to isolated Pi processes without turning projects into agents.
enable_subagents_detail: Loads the pinned pi-subagents extension for new Pi processes. The global proxy also applies to its package download and child requests.
compact_session_detail: Summarize older context to recover model capacity.
clone_session_detail: Continue this branch in a new independent session.
export_session_detail: Save a portable transcript of this session.
rename_session_detail: Choose a short name that makes this thread easy to find later.
empty_detail: Open several projects, each with its own workspace, Pi process, and sessions.
starter_explain_prompt: Explain this repository's structure and suggest a good first task.
starter_fix_prompt: Inspect this repository for an important bug and propose a safe fix.
starter_plan_detail: Turn an idea into a concrete implementation path.
starter_plan_prompt: Help me turn a feature idea into a concrete implementation plan.
starter_review_detail: Find the highest-risk issue and a useful next step.
starter_review_prompt: Review the current working tree, identify the highest-risk issue, and suggest the next concrete improvement.
starter_verify_detail: Discover the right validation commands and fix a failure.
starter_verify_prompt: Discover this repository's validation commands, run the relevant checks, and fix the first meaningful failure.
queue_follow_up: Add a follow-up while Pi is working…
steer_detail: Deliver after the current tool call, before Pi continues.
follow_up_detail: Wait until the current agent turn has fully completed.
prompt_placeholder: Ask this agent to work in its repository…
send_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline
available_commands_detail: Insert a Pi prompt template, extension command, or skill.
fork_session_detail: Later messages leave the active branch. Pi keeps the session tree and returns this prompt to the composer for editing.
fork_session_checking: Checking whether this turn has a workspace checkpoint…
fork_session_with_checkpoint: Later messages leave the active branch and the Git workspace returns to its state before this prompt. A safety checkpoint is created before any files change.
fork_session_without_checkpoint: Later messages leave the active branch, but current workspace files will not change because this turn has no Git checkpoint.
context_files_detail: Search tracked workspace files and attach their text to the next prompt.
select_file_preview: Select a text file to preview it.
no_code_changes: No code changes in this project.
delete_agent_detail: Remove this project and its session references from the desktop app.
delete_agent_files_safe: The running process will stop. Original Pi session files and repository files will not be deleted.
delete_last_project_disabled: Add another project before removing this one.
